rationale: Builds on the current recurrent-tail baseline instead of changing the training dynamics. The new idea is export-path specific: after training, score late-block matrices by quantization damage per added byte and greedily keep a few under a strict byte budget. That directly targets `final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb`, preserves the proven reverse recurrent tail, and spends remaining artifact budget on tensors most likely to survive as useful fp16 exceptions. I also compressed some code paths to stay under the 1500-line limit.
title: Budgeted Tail-Sensitive FP16 Rescue
